name: correct-plural
message: Ist «Me gustan los idiomas» korrekt? Erkläre kurz die Grammatik.
review: Keep the correct sentence. los idiomas is the plural grammatical subject; me is an indirect-object pronoun. Explain in German.

name: completed-past
message: Correct «Ayer voy al museo» and explain the tense. Keep my meaning.
review: Ayer fui al museo. Explain the completed past event in English; do not change the destination.

name: gender-agreement
message: Please check: Mi hermana es muy simpático.
review: Correct simpático to simpática because hermana is feminine. Avoid unrelated rewrites.

name: correct-age
review: Say it is correct. Explain tener for age in English; do not imply an unchanged sentence is a correction.

name: meaning-contrast
message: Was ist der Unterschied zwischen «es aburrido» und «está aburrido»?
review: Explain langweilig versus gelangweilt with examples. Do not reduce all ser/estar uses to permanent versus temporary.

name: conversation
message: Hola, me llamo Elena y me gusta la historia. ¿Y a ti?
review: Reply naturally in simple Spanish, stay on school/history, and ask one short question.
